newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Finances buys Aeroleasing operating units.
newsitem.headline: TAG Finances buys Aeroleasing operating units.

text.p: TAG Finances SA said TAG Group would acquire all the operational activities of privately-held business jet charter and management company Aeroleasing Holding SA in early 1998. Financial terms were not disclosed.
TAG Group, the controlling shareholder in watchmaker TAG Heuer, distributes Canadair products in Arab League countries.

"TAG Group intends to put all its know-how and experience at the disposition of Aeroleasing in order to ensure the expansion of its international activities from its base in Geneva," it said. TAG managing director Jacques Rosset said Aeroleasing had 10 jets of its own and operated eight more for clients.
